resources/js/components/admin/data-table: externa-core is the source of this item. It uses STRING_LIMITS.SEARCH for the search maxLength (the registry hard-codes 255, same value), and the search is on InputGroup (search icon as an inline-start addon) instead of an absolutely positioned icon; the registry should take this version.
resources/js/components/admin/files/file: externa-core's card takes an AdminFileRow; the registry FileCard takes name, preview, cover, tags, badges and actions. Layout (1.4.0): the whole card (file or folder) is a 1:1 AspectRatio. The preview flex-fills the space above a 40px name row, edge to edge (object-cover on the focal point, so slightly landscape; folders show the folder icon on the same tile), with only the selection checkbox and corner badges on it. The name row holds the truncated name (Tooltip), an icon-xs tag button whose HoverCard lists the tags on hover / focus (shown only when the file has tags; a click does not select the card) and an icon-xs ⋮ DropdownMenu that renders the same actions as the right-click ContextMenu (file-action-menu-items.tsx). Grid: 2 columns below sm, repeat(auto-fill, minmax(15rem, 1fr)) from sm up. The card surface has no role or tab stop (axe nested-interactive). The registry FileCard should follow.
externa-core's grid takes its file rows, permissions and drag-and-drop callbacks; the registry FileGrid is generic over the item.
